description: Zendesk Support for an agent: search and read tickets, their comments, users and groups; create tickets, reply to the requester, add internal notes, set status and priority, assign and tag, with every write governed.

secrets.name: ZENDESK
secrets.description: The connected Zendesk account: subdomain, agent email and API token

actions.name: search-tickets
actions.description: Search tickets with Zendesk's search syntax, e.g. status<solved requester:dana@example.com tags:billing. Returns up to 10 tickets a page in results, with count and next_page. Sort by updated_at, created_at, priority, status or ticket_type (relevance when left out). Pass page for the next page. Zendesk returns at most 1000 results a query; narrow it with a date such as created>2026-10-01. New or changed tickets can take a few minutes to appear in search.

query.description: The search, in Zendesk's search syntax. type:ticket is added for you.

sort_by.description: What to sort by. Leave out to sort by relevance.

page.description: The page number, from 1. Leave out for page 1. next_page in the response is null on the last page.

actions.name: list-tickets
actions.description: List the account's tickets, 10 a page, in ascending id order unless sort is given. Each ticket has id, subject, status, priority, type, requester_id, assignee_id, group_id, tags and dates. When meta.has_more is true, pass meta.after_cursor as cursor for the next page. Archived tickets (closed for more than 120 days) are left out by Zendesk. Use search-tickets to filter.

sort.description: The order. A leading - sorts descending: -updated_at for the most recently updated.

cursor.description: meta.after_cursor from the previous page, when meta.has_more is true. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: get-ticket
actions.description: Get one ticket: subject, description (the opening comment), status, priority, type, requester_id, assignee_id, group_id, organization_id, tags, custom fields and dates. Read its conversation with list-ticket-comments.

ticket_id.description: The ticket's id, from search-tickets, list-tickets or list-user-tickets.

actions.name: list-ticket-comments
actions.description: List a ticket's comments, 10 a page, oldest to newest unless sort is -created_at. Each comment has id, author_id, body, html_body, public (false for an internal note), attachments and created_at. When meta.has_more is true, pass meta.after_cursor as cursor for the next page.

ticket_id.description: The ticket's id, from search-tickets, list-tickets or list-user-tickets.

sort.description: created_at for oldest to newest (the default), -created_at for newest to oldest.

cursor.description: meta.after_cursor from the previous page, when meta.has_more is true. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: list-user-tickets
actions.description: List the tickets one user requested, 10 a page, by ticket id. Use it to see a customer's history. When meta.has_more is true, pass meta.after_cursor as cursor for the next page. Archived tickets are included.

user_id.description: The user's id, from search-users, or a ticket's requester_id or assignee_id.

cursor.description: meta.after_cursor from the previous page, when meta.has_more is true. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: search-users
actions.description: Find users (customers and agents) by name, email or other text, e.g. an email address or role:agent. Returns up to 20 users a page in users, each with id, name, email, role, organization_id and tags, with count and next_page. Pass page for the next page.

query.description: What to search for: a name, an email address, or Zendesk search syntax such as role:agent.

page.description: The page number, from 1. Leave out for page 1. next_page in the response is null on the last page.

actions.name: get-user
actions.description: Get one user: name, email, role (end-user, agent or admin), organization_id, time zone, locale, tags, whether suspended, and custom user fields.

user_id.description: The user's id, from search-users, or a ticket's requester_id or assignee_id.

actions.name: list-groups
actions.description: List the account's agent groups, 50 a page, each with id, name, description and whether it is the default group. Use a group id with assign-ticket or create-ticket. When meta.has_more is true, pass meta.after_cursor as cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: meta.after_cursor from the previous page, when meta.has_more is true. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: create-ticket
actions.description: Create one ticket with a subject and an opening comment. The requester is the user given by requester_id, or by requester email (Zendesk creates an end user for an email it does not know), or the connected agent when both are left out. A public opening comment can be emailed to the requester by the account's triggers. Read back by ticket id; the subject must match. Limitation: no idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second ticket. Custom fields and attachments are not set here.

body.description: The opening comment, as plain text.

public.description: false to make the opening comment an internal note. Leave out for public (Zendesk's default).

requester_id.description: The requester's user id, from search-users. Give this or requester, not both.

requester.description: The requester by email, with a name for a new end user. Give this or requester_id, not both.

name.description: The requester's name, used when Zendesk creates the user.

group_id.description: The group to put it in, from list-groups.

assignee_id.description: The agent to assign it to, a user id from search-users (role:agent).

items.description: One tag: lowercase letters, digits and _ : / . - with no spaces, e.g. vip or billing_issue.

tags.description: Tags to put on the ticket.

actions.name: reply-to-ticket
actions.description: Send a public reply on one ticket. The requester and the ticket's CCs can be emailed it by the account's triggers. Read back from the ticket's newest comment; it must belong to this update's audit and be public. Limitation: no idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can send a second reply. A closed ticket cannot be replied to. Attachments are not offered.

ticket_id.description: The ticket's id, from search-tickets, list-tickets or list-user-tickets.

actions.name: add-internal-note
actions.description: Add an internal note to one ticket. Agents see it; the requester does not. Read back from the ticket's newest comment; it must belong to this update's audit and not be public. Limitation: no idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can add a second note. A closed ticket cannot take a note.

ticket_id.description: The ticket's id, from search-tickets, list-tickets or list-user-tickets.

actions.name: set-ticket-status
actions.description: Set one ticket's status to open, pending, hold or solved. Solving it can email the requester through the account's triggers, and Zendesk closes a solved ticket later by its own automations. Read back by ticket id; the status must be the one given. Limitation: a closed ticket cannot be changed, and an account trigger can change the status again after the update. Custom ticket statuses are not set here.

ticket_id.description: The ticket's id, from search-tickets, list-tickets or list-user-tickets.

status.description: open (an agent is working on it), pending (waiting on the requester), hold (waiting on a third party) or solved.

actions.name: set-ticket-priority
actions.description: Set one ticket's priority to low, normal, high or urgent. Read back by ticket id; the priority must be the one given. Limitation: a closed ticket cannot be changed, and an account trigger can change the priority again after the update.

ticket_id.description: The ticket's id, from search-tickets, list-tickets or list-user-tickets.

actions.name: assign-ticket
actions.description: Assign one ticket to an agent, and optionally move it to a group the agent belongs to. The agent must belong to the ticket's group, or to the group given. Read back by ticket id; the assignee must be the one given. Limitation: a closed ticket cannot be changed, and the group is sent but not read back.

ticket_id.description: The ticket's id, from search-tickets, list-tickets or list-user-tickets.

assignee_id.description: The agent to assign it to, a user id from search-users (role:agent).

group_id.description: The group to move it to, from list-groups. Leave out to keep its group.

actions.name: add-ticket-tags
actions.description: Add one tag to a ticket. The ticket's other tags stay. Read back from the ticket's tags; the tag must be among them. Limitation: removing a tag is not offered (see the pack README). A closed ticket cannot be changed.

ticket_id.description: The ticket's id, from search-tickets, list-tickets or list-user-tickets.

tag.description: One tag: lowercase letters, digits and _ : / . - with no spaces, e.g. vip or billing_issue.

policies.name: zendesk: approve replying to a requester
